profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Paycor
profile.summary:
As a Principal Software Engineer at Paycor, I lead the development of high-performance, cloud-based applications. With extensive experience in C#, Azure, and React, I've driven innovative solutions that significantly impact both clients and our organization.

My approach combines strategic thinking with a passion for collaboration, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver software products that exceed business requirements. I've played a key role in designing systems for banking integrations, payroll and tax calculation, hiring and onboarding, and retail.

I'm always eager to learn and tackle whatever new challenges lie ahead.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead teams of 5-8 software engineers in an Agile environment to deliver solutions that meet or exceed business requirements.
- Design and develop high performance, cloud-based applications using C#, Azure, and React.
- Create standards for code reviews, unit tests, and automated QA processes to uphold code integrity and application performance.
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and operations, to deliver innovative software products.
- Interview and qualify applicants for my teams, and assist with interviews on other teams.
- Mentor junior engineers, provide guidance on best practices, coding standards, and career development.
- Member of architecture collaboration council, sharing learnings from our teams with other areas of the organization.
- Member of UX council, advocating for best practices, standardizing UI libraries across the organization
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Computer Science · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · C# · .NET · Problem Solving · React.js · JavaScript · Microsoft SQL Server
